subject: Printer outage on the sales floor
content: The shared laser printer in Scranton jammed repeatedly this week. Alan Prentice reported that reams of paper were wasted and asked facilities for a service visit. Until it is fixed, please route print jobs to the reception printer.

subject: Paper reorder for Harborview Realty
content: Bianca Rao closed a repeat order of forty cases of multipurpose paper for Harborview Realty. The Stamford branch will fulfill from local stock and follow up on a glossy paper sample the client requested.

subject: Late delivery complaint from Meridian Accounting
content: Meridian Accounting filed a complaint that a paper shipment arrived three days late. Carl Winters apologized, issued a credit, and flagged the Utica warehouse dispatch delay for review.

subject: Fire drill schedule
content: The Nashua branch will hold a fire drill next Thursday. Dana Osei is the floor warden and will confirm that all exits and extinguishers are unobstructed.

subject: Slip hazard reported
content: Evan Brooks reported a slip hazard from a leaking cooler in the Akron break room. Facilities placed a mat and scheduled a repair to prevent injury.

subject: Buffalo monthly branch update
content: Farah Nazari summarized the month for the Buffalo branch: paper sales up modestly, one printer problem resolved, and a customer complaint closed. Morale is steady.

subject: Inventory discrepancy
content: Grace Lindqvist found a count discrepancy on multipurpose paper in the Albany warehouse. A recount matched the system after correcting a mislabeled pallet.

subject: Quarterly planning meeting
content: In the Rochester planning meeting, Hector Alvarez and Omar Haddad agreed to prioritize paper sales targets and to budget for a printer replacement after repeated problems.

subject: Recognition for Ivy Chen
content: Priya Nair recognized Ivy Chen for resolving a difficult customer complaint at the Syracuse branch. A note was added to the employee file.

subject: Quarterly target review
content: Jonah Mbeki reviewed the Binghamton branch sales targets. Paper sales are close to goal; a push on Ironwood Construction and two other accounts should close the gap.

subject: Call with Lakeside Dental about reorder
content: Karen Dowd called Lakeside Dental to confirm a paper reorder and check satisfaction after a prior late delivery. The client was pleased and increased the order.

subject: Cooling unit failure on the sales floor
content: The cooling unit above the Stamford sales floor gave out during the warmest week of the year. Staff propped the doors open and brought desk fans from home. Liam Fitzgerald chased the contractor daily until it was running again.

subject: Recurring printer maintenance
content: Marisol Reyes logged the third printer breakdown this month at the Nashua branch. Toner is low and the fuser needs replacement. Victor Osmond approved the maintenance budget so the printer does not disrupt paper sample runs.

subject: New paper account opened
content: Nadia Petrov opened a new account with Northgate Law for recycled copy paper. Alan Prentice helped prepare the quote. This lifts the Akron branch toward its quarterly paper sales target.

subject: Damaged goods complaint
content: Riverbend Logistics reported water-damaged cartons on delivery. Omar Haddad arranged a replacement and asked the Buffalo warehouse to improve pallet wrapping.
